defmodule SecureAPI.TokenAuth do
  @moduledoc """
  Token-based authentication for the SecureAPI service.
  Uses HMAC-SHA256 for token integrity verification.
  """

  @secret Application.compile_env(:secure_api, :hmac_secret, :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32))
  @token_ttl 3600
  @allowed_algorithms ["HS256", "HS384", "HS512"]

  defstruct [:user_id, :issued_at, :expires_at, :permissions]

  def generate_token(user_id, permissions) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    payload = %{
      "sub" => user_id,
      "iat" => now,
      "exp" => now + @token_ttl,
      "perms" => permissions,
      "alg" => "HS256"
    }
    encoded_payload = payload |> :erlang.term_to_binary() |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
    signature = compute_signature("HS256", encoded_payload)
    "#{encoded_payload}.#{signature}"
  end

  def verify_token(token) when is_binary(token) do
    case String.split(token, ".") do
      [encoded_payload, signature] ->
        with {:ok, payload} <- decode_payload(encoded_payload),
             {:ok, _} <- verify_algorithm(payload),
             {:ok, _} <- verify_signature(payload, encoded_payload, signature),
             {:ok, _} <- verify_expiration(payload) do
          {:ok, %__MODULE__{
            user_id: payload["sub"],
            issued_at: payload["iat"],
            expires_at: payload["exp"],
            permissions: payload["perms"]
          }}
        end
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp decode_payload(encoded) do
    case Base.url_decode64(encoded, padding: false) do
      {:ok, binary} ->
        try do
          {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(binary, [:safe])}
        rescue
          _ -> {:error, :invalid_payload}
        end
      :error ->
        {:error, :invalid_encoding}
    end
  end

  defp verify_algorithm(%{"alg" => alg}) when alg in @allowed_algorithms do
    {:ok, alg}
  end
  defp verify_algorithm(_), do: {:error, :invalid_algorithm}

  defp verify_signature(%{"alg" => alg}, encoded_payload, provided_sig) do
    expected = compute_signature(alg, encoded_payload)
    if secure_compare(expected, provided_sig) do
      {:ok, :valid}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp verify_expiration(%{"exp" => exp}) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if exp > now do
      {:ok, :not_expired}
    else
      {:error, :token_expired}
    end
  end
  defp verify_expiration(_), do: {:error, :missing_expiration}

  defp compute_signature(algorithm, data) do
    hash_alg = case algorithm do
      "HS256" -> :sha256
      "HS384" -> :sha384
      "HS512" -> :sha512
    end
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, hash_alg, @secret, data)
    |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) != byte_size(b), do: false
  defp secure_compare(a, b) do
    a_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(a)
    b_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(b)
    Enum.zip(a_bytes, b_bytes)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {x, y}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(x, y)) end)
    |> Kernel.==(0)
  end

  # Admin endpoint protection
  def authorize(token_struct, required_permission) do
    if required_permission in token_struct.permissions do
      {:ok, :authorized}
    else
      {:error, :forbidden}
    end
  end

  # Rate limiting state
  def check_rate_limit(user_id, action, limits \\ %{"read" => 100, "write" => 20}) do
    key = "#{user_id}:#{action}"
    current = get_counter(key)
    max = Map.get(limits, action, 10)
    if current < max do
      increment_counter(key)
      {:ok, :allowed}
    else
      {:error, :rate_limited}
    end
  end

  defp get_counter(key) do
    case :persistent_term.get({__MODULE__, :counters, key}, nil) do
      nil -> 0
      val -> val
    end
  end

  defp increment_counter(key) do
    current = get_counter(key)
    :persistent_term.put({__MODULE__, :counters, key}, current + 1)
  end
end
